title: Where a visit happens is a relationship, and its cardinality is a stated choice
note: AI-AG-002, 总体 SRS 9.1: a relationship's cardinality, ownership, lifecycle dependence, optionality and cross-process flags are recorded here because the mapping stage cannot recover them later.

items.label: midwife-interview.txt
items.content: A woman is usually seen at the same post, but when it is closed she goes to the neighbouring one and the visit is written where it took place.

expected.summary: Registered the facility as an entity of its own, taken from the facility list, and related it to the antenatal visit. The relationship is many visits to one facility, the visit's own record of where it happened rather than the woman's home post, so it is not lifecycle dependent and it is required. Whether a visit at a closed post is written against the usual post or the actual one is stated in the interview as the actual one, so that is recorded as the decision rather than asked.

decisions.subject: rel.visit.atFacility

selected.option: many visits to one facility, ownership to the facility

alternatives.option: one facility recorded as an attribute of the woman
alternatives.reasonRejected: The interview says the visit is written where it took place, which is not necessarily the woman's usual post.
One visit happens at one place, so many-to-many would let a visit be counted twice in a facility's totals.

decisions.rationale: The place of service is a fact about the visit, and the facility list is already a register of distinct objects.

description.default: A post or unit where antenatal visits take place, listed by code and district.

value.name: takes place at facility
candidateExpressions: the organisation unit the event is recorded against

value.name: Visit at another post
value.purpose: Record a visit that took place away from the woman's usual post.
steps: the woman attends a neighbouring post
the midwife at that post records the visit against this facility
value.outcome: The visit counts for the facility where it happened.

questions.text: When a visit is recorded at a neighbouring post, should the pregnancy's register also show which post it was, or is the visit's own facility enough?

suggestions.rationale: One place per visit is what the totals need.

suggestions.text: Also keep the woman's usual post on the visit
suggestions.rationale: Lets the usual post see the visits it missed.
